"message": "Create the daily morning briefing for Alvin to post in Discord #general. Keep it concise, bullet-style.

Include 3 sections:
1) HK Weather today + tomorrow (short, actionable; mention rain/thunderstorm likelihood and temps).
   - Prefer: https://wttr.in/Hong_Kong?format=j1 (JSON) or https://wttr.in/Hong_Kong?1 (text).
   - Avoid lat/long API calls that can error (e.g., latitude/longitude length mismatch). If fetch fails, say “Weather: unavailable right now (fetch failed).”
2) MTR service status (check https://www.mtr.com.hk/alert/ryg_line_status_lite.xml).
   - If all lines are green (or grey for ended service), say: “MTR: No major delays reported (as of <time>).”
   - If any line is yellow/red/typhoon/other non-green status, list the affected line(s) with the status and any message text.
3) 3–5 bullets of OpenClaw/AI setup + productivity + cost-saving tips.

End with: “Anything you want me to prioritize today?”",
